NONE: › abbreviation for head-up display: in a computer game, the part of the screen that shows information such as the player's score, how much time they have left, etc.
（在電腦遊戲螢幕中顯示得分或所剩時間等資訊的）抬頭顯示部分（head-up display的縮寫）

example: Sometimes a game's HUD can be distracting.
有時候遊戲的抬頭顯示部分會擾亂注意力。

NONE: › to come close together in a group, or to hold your arms and legs close to your body, especially because of cold or fear
（尤指因寒冷或恐懼而）擠成一團，聚集在一起；蜷縮，縮成一團

C: › a small group of people or things that are close together
› to get into a group in order to talk secretly
› US a group formed by the members of a team in American football before they separate and continue to play
集合列隊（指美式橄欖球隊員在繼續比賽前聚成一團磋商戰術）

example: Everyone huddled round the fire to keep warm.
所有人都擠在爐火旁取暖。
It was so cold that we huddled together for warmth.
太冷了，我們只好擠在一起取暖。
Sophie was so frightened by the noise of the fireworks that she huddled (up) in a corner of the room.
蘇菲被煙火爆竹的聲音嚇壞了，在屋角縮成一團。
A small group of people stood in a huddle at the bus stop.
一小群人在公共汽車站擠成一團。
The judges went into a huddle to decide the winner.
評委們圍成一團商量決定誰是獲勝者。
We stood huddled together for warmth.
我們站在那裡擠作一團取暖。
